front.text: 我們今天都在學校學習。

back.text: We are all studying at school today.
back.notes:
Wǒmen jīntiān dōu zài xuéxiào xuéxí.

An adverb meaning “all”; it indicates that every member of “we” is included.

back.text: dǎ diànhuà - make a phone call
méiyǒu - not have; there is not
hào - number; day of a month
zěnmeyàng - how about?; how is/was it?
jǐ - how many; several; a few

back.notes:
wǒ kàn le shū

了 indicates a completed action, marking that the action of reading the book is finished.

back.text: zhù - to live; reside; to stop
The book is on the table.
back.notes:
Shū zài zhuōzi shang.

A localizer meaning “on,” showing that the book is located on the table.

back.text: bùdàn... érqiě... - not only... but also...
We invite you to come and work at the company.
back.notes:
Wǒmen qǐng nǐ lái gōngsì gōngzuò.

In this sentence, '來' (lái) is a directional verb meaning 'to come' or 'to arrive'. It indicates movement toward the location of the company ('公司') to perform the action of working ('工作'), linking the invitation to the destination.

back.text: zhāng - measure word for paper/flat objects

front.text: 你現在能做這些工作嗎？

back.text: Can you do these tasks now?
back.notes:
Nǐ xiànzài néng zuò zhèxiē gōngzuò ma?

A modal verb meaning “can” or “be able to,” expressing ability.

back.text: My friend and I study at school.
back.notes:
Wǒ hé péngyou zài xuéxiào xuéxí.

A conjunction meaning “and,” connecting “I” and “friend” as joint participants.

back.text: huí - to return; to reply; to go back

back.notes:
tā yǒu yī gè érzi

他 is the third-person singular masculine pronoun meaning 'he'.

back.text: kāi - to open; to start; to operate (a vehicle)
qǐng - please; invite; to treat someone to something
I have a very good friend.
back.notes:
Wǒ yǒu yí ge hěn hǎo de péngyou.

A general measure word linking the numeral “one” to the noun “friend.”

back.text: kuài - lump; piece; sum of money
